article.title_es: Compassion House: despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn
article.title_en: Compassion House: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: Compassion House Community Development Corporation es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: Compassion House Community Development Corporation is a food pantry in Brooklyn listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC.
Está ubicada en 43 George St, Brooklyn, NY 11206.
La despensa funciona el primer y tercer jueves del mes.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 43 George St, Brooklyn, NY 11206.
It is open Thursdays from 9am to 11:30am.
The pantry runs on the 1st and 3rd Thursday of the month.
visit_tips_es: Vaya un primer o tercer jueves, entre 9am y 11:30am.
Llame antes para confirmar el horario y preguntar qué alimentos dan.
La lista no indica qué requisitos hay, así que pregunte por teléfono.
visit_tips_en: Go on a 1st or 3rd Thursday, between 9am and 11:30am.
Call ahead to confirm the schedule and ask what food is given.
The listing does not say what the requirements are, so ask by phone.
